name: AIGMos Master Map
purpose: Deterministically project an existing normalized graph into a dense framed 2D SVG map using layout and presentation measurements extracted from the reference SVG. This ruleset changes observation only; it does not create or infer source semantics.

hierarchy.rule: Graph depth is mapped only to visual hierarchy. The renderer MUST NOT reinterpret depth as a domain class.

layout.container_width_rule: Available width is divided among explicit children; renderer may wrap children to additional rows but MUST preserve child order.

edges.semantic_rule: Edge color/style is selected only from an explicit renderer mapping supplied by the view. Unknown edge kinds use default; the ruleset MUST NOT infer semantic roles from names.

projection_policy.root: selected context identity or JSON pointer
projection_policy.children: explicit containment children in source order when order is semantic; otherwise deterministic stable order
projection_policy.non_containment_edges: overlay only; never used to invent container hierarchy
projection_policy.leaf: card or chip depending on available structured fields
projection_policy.overflow: wrap and expand canvas; never drop nodes silently
projection_policy.information_density: Prefer compact complete structural grouping over decorative whitespace.

hard_gates: renderer creates semantic identity not present in normalized graph
renderer uses filename or label text to infer hierarchy
renderer drops a visible in-scope node without explicit filtering
visual position becomes semantic source of truth
